newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Imperio H1 net down.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Imperio H1 net down.

text.p: Portuguese insurance company Companhia de Seguros Imperio said its net profit dropped 32 percent to 26 million escudos in the first half of 1996, compared to the same year ago period.
Its revenues rose to 41.214 billion escudos in the first half of 1996 from 34.02 billion in the same year ago period.
Revenues from life insurance rose 70 percent year-on-year to 8.4 billion escudos and non-life revenues rose 21 percent to 32.8 billion escudos.
"The growth seen in life insurance resulted from an ambitious programme selling insurance products in branches of Banco Mello Comercial," a statement said.
